0.value:
body_proportions is a panel of sliders for reshaping a body: one row per segment, each with a length, a width and a depth factor.

HOW IT IS USED:
Patch its 'limb_scale' outlet to the 'limb_scale' inlet of mgl_body, mgl_body_orientation, mgl_smpl_mesh or mgl_smpl_heatmap - they all speak the same vocabulary, so one panel can drive the skeleton and the skin together.

It sends the whole set of factors, as a dict, on every edit and once when the patch opens, so the body needs no priming: open the patch and the saved proportions are already applied.

THE FACTORS:
1.0 means unchanged. Length moves the joint at the far end of the segment and stretches the drawn limb; width and depth fatten or thin it. Each segment is named for the joint it ENDS at: left_upper_leg is hip to knee, left_hand is wrist to knuckles. The pelvis bowl and the shoulder blades keep their drawn shape under a length factor and only move what hangs off them.

The rows are spine_lower, spine_mid, spine_upper, spine_to_neck, neck, head, and for each side hip, upper_leg, lower_leg, foot, toes, heel, shoulder_blade, collar, upper_arm, lower_arm, hand, fingers.

Reshaping costs nothing beyond the normal draw on mgl_body, so the factors can be animated freely.

SYMMETRY:
With 'symmetric' ticked (the default) an edit to a left row is copied to the matching right row and the other way round. Untick it and each side keeps its own values - how you make a lopsided body on purpose. Values arriving at 'scales in' are not mirrored.

SETTING IT FROM THE PATCH:
'scales in' takes a dict {segment: factors}. A segment name can be a row name, a name without its side (upper_arm sets both sides), left, right or all. One number sets the length only, two set width and depth, three set all three. The rows update and the whole set is sent on. 'reset' puts every row back to 1.0 and sends.

A message naming one row, such as 'left_upper_arm 1.2 1 1', sets that row as an edit would: mirrored to the other side if 'symmetric' is ticked, then sent.

Its rows are also saved by the presets node.

SYNTAX:
body_proportions

It takes no arguments.

EXAMPLE:
body_proportions

INPUTS and PARAMETERS:

scales in:
A dict of factors, as above.

symmetric:
Mirror edits between left and right rows.

reset:
Back to 1.0 everywhere.

spine_lower ... right_fingers:
One row per segment: length, width, depth.

OUTPUTS:

limb_scale:
A dict of every segment's three factors.

RELATED:
mgl_body, whose page lists the limb_scale messages those nodes also accept directly. smpl_beta_editor sets a body's base proportions from SMPL shape values; this scales on top of that.
